annotation.title_clean: Codi sobre l'Ètica de la Intel·ligència Artificial d'Andorra
annotation.title_en: Andorra Code on the Ethics of Artificial Intelligence
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Govern d'Andorra (Secretaria d'Estat de Transformació Digital i Telecomunicacions)
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
Council of Europe Framework Convention on AI
annotation.summary_en: Andorra's voluntary Code on the Ethics of AI, issued by the government, sets values, ten principles and trustworthy-AI requirements aligned with UNESCO, OECD, Council of Europe and EU frameworks. It gives recommendations for the public sector, private sector and citizens, and covers ESG, neurorights and generative AI. It does not address robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Voluntary code; may be required for public procurement where law permits; does not replace future regulation
Ten principles including human-centred AI, proportionality, robustness, transparency, human oversight, accountability
Seven trustworthy-AI requirements adapted from the EU ethics guidelines
Recommends Human Rights by Design and fundamental rights impact assessments
Sector-specific recommendations for public sector, private sector and citizens; covers neurorights and generative AI
